armGroups.label: Single dose of AS1986NS
armGroups.description: Single dose of AS1986NS administered as an injection through peripheral intravenous access.

interventions.name: AS1986NS
interventions.description: Single dose, IV, 100 µg of AS1986NS

primaryOutcomes.description: Demonstrate that AS1986NS is 'safe' as a microdosed \<100 µg, \<100 µL, 1 mg/mL per patient dose when introduced intravenously as a bolus through peripheral intravenous access by evaluation of the Adverse Events (AEs), including Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), that occur in patients treated with AS1986NS
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Enrollment to 30 days post single infusion

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* suspected prostate cancer warranting standard of care multi-core prostate biopsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients receiving same-day therapeutic Lutetium-177 or Actinium-225 PSMA receptor radiation isotope therapy treatment
* Patients with pre-existing, impaired or abnormal hepatic function, renal function, cardiac function, and abnormal elevated temperature
* Patients with a creatinine clearance cutoﬀ (CrCl) of \< 60 mL/min

locations.facility: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai (ISMMS)
